name: classic
description: Classic is the standard gamemode where players guess the daily idol based on clues.

name: blurry
description: Blurry mode presents a blurry image of the idol that gradually becomes clearer with each guess.

name: pixelated
description: Pixelated mode shows a pixelated image of an album cover that gradually becomes clearer with each guess.

name: inkit
description: InkIt mode: draw on a blank sheet to reveal the idol photo and guess who it is.
